Target / packet: `ai-polynomial-features` · `C2`. Prerequisites: `ai:linear-regression-fit`.

Nearest / distinct payoff: `linear-regression-fit` → `outlier-flattens-line` (existing registered artifact; evidence applicability pending). Unlike raw-x line fitting, this transforms the feature and separates parameter linearity from input-space curvature.

Primary finite model: Data x=[-2,-1,0,1,2], y=x². Raw intercept+slope fit is yhat=2 with SSE14. Feature z=x² gives coefficient1 intercept0 and SSE0.

Countercase and boundary: Transfer x=3 gives raw2 versus polynomial9; fitting perfectly here is not a generalization guarantee on unknown functions or noisy data.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether a coefficient-linear model can draw a curved input-space relation; recall linearity in which variables.

Required evidence: Display x→z→prediction transformation and curved output, not just fit scores.
